mapping.render_path: KoreanRuntime::InterceptPrint -> Queue -> KoreanRuntime::Draw -> ImGui foreground D3D9 overlay

supporting_graphics_atlas.note: The atlas contains the Heart Attack speech-bubble panel and related HUD art; the bubble panel itself carries no localized baked text, so the reported Korean bubble lettering is a runtime draw rather than a DDS text cell.

mapping.reason: KoreanTextOverlayTest suppresses resolved stock glyph output and redraws every resolved Korean runtime draw through the same DrawCommand path. B170's compact policy is ID-agnostic for valid translated rows and is selected from captured stock cellHeight/scaleY state.

shared_material_fix.policy: valid translated draws with logical font height <=24 receive an 8-direction dark keyline derived from stock ARGB, 1-2 screen px, clipped to the pre-existing calculated Korean text rectangle
shared_material_fix.source_comment_scope: The implementation explicitly records IGR-006/007 as the compact HUD/speech-bubble readability regressions addressed by this policy.

build_validation_reused_exact_source.reuse_basis: Current hooks_localization.cpp SHA-256 exactly matches the validation-bearing B170 source bytes.
